text:
Maria Ramos: Quick sync — want to lock a 45m postmortem for last week's outage. Suggest Wed 10:00 or Thu 15:00. Core attendees = eng leads, infra, product PM, SRE. Who's required?

Jake O'Neil: Wed works for me. Please include @Leah and @Samir. I can cover serving/runtime notes.

Samir Patel: Thu better for me, but can do Wed if needed. I'd like the "failure timeline" slot to be 10–15m.

Leah Cho: Wed is fine. Please add a short pre-read with logs + incident timeline. @Maria can you drop links?

Maria Ramos: Yep — pre-read in thread below. Also: propose agenda draft:

```text
- 10m: timeline & impact
- 10m: root cause analysis (what broke)
- 10m: mitigations we did
- 10m: follow-ups & ownership
- 5m: quick retro on process
```

Olivia (prod): Can we include a customer comms owner? @Olivia

Olivia (prod): that's me, happy to.

Jake O'Neil: Also, bring the RFC that touched the deployment config — short mention. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/842

deploy-bot: Calendar event created: Wed 2026-03-25 10:00 — https://calendar.redwood.com/event/abc123

Maria Ramos: Good. Final attendees: Maria Ramos, Jake O'Neil, Samir Patel, Leah Cho, Olivia (prod), deploy-bot, anyone else?

Tom (intern): Can I join as observer? low bandwidth.

Maria Ramos: Yes, Tom welcome. We'll keep observer slots.

Samir Patel: For follow-ups, suggest owners: monitoring alerts — @Leah; config rollback guard — @Jake; postmortem write-up — @Maria.

Leah Cho: ack :thumbsup: 

Jake O'Neil: ack. I'll prepare the quick diffs and the script snippet we ran:

```bash
# snapshot of rollback
kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-runtime -n prod
```

Maria Ramos: Thanks. I'll post pre-read links and attach logs by EOD.

Olivia (prod): I'll draft the customer note template during the meeting.

Maria Ramos: Last note — can we keep the meeting focused and timebox strictly? If deep investigations needed we'll spin-off a follow-up engineering deep-dive.

Leah Cho: sounds good.

Maria Ramos: Meeting notes and action tracker will be uploaded to the incident board after the call. Please add any questions here before the pre-read goes out.
